Guarding

Mobile patrols & alarm response

Experienced guards and vehicle patrols, night and day, every day of the week. We check what should be locked and are on site fast when the alarm goes off.

What's included

  1. 01

    Night patrols

    Planned and irregular rounds that make our visits hard to predict.

  2. 02

    Lock and door checks

    Doors, windows, gates and lighting are checked and fixed on the spot.

  3. 03

    Alarm response

    We respond to alarms and assess the situation before it escalates.

  4. 04

    A report after every round

    You see what was checked and what deviated.

Ideal for

  • Industrial and commercial premises
  • Parking garages
  • Housing associations
  • Shopping centres and retail parks
